name: code_debugger
description: Reads and audits local projects under /home/s-ndrlm-r/Projects, maps frontend/backend/API relationships, proposes fixes, and applies write/delete actions only after explicit host confirmation.

action.description: Action to run: audit, preview_fix, apply_fix, delete_file, read_file, or list_tree.

project_path.description: Absolute path to the project folder. Must be inside /home/s-ndrlm-r/Projects.

issue_id.description: Issue ID returned by the audit, for preview_fix or apply_fix.

target_file.description: Relative file path inside the selected project, used by read_file or delete_file.

confirmation.description: Deprecated. Use approval_text from the host approval flow.

admin_confirmed.description: Host app sets true only after approval.

approval_text.description: Exact APPROVE ACTION phrase supplied by the host approval flow.

max_files.description: Maximum number of files returned by list_tree.
